title: Ali's Careful Judgment
paragraphs: Ali bin Abi Thalib dikenal di kalangan para sahabat karena mempertimbangkan keputusan dengan cermat alih-alih bereaksi cepat, bahkan dalam situasi di mana orang lain mengharapkan tanggapan segera darinya.
Ketika menghadapi perselisihan rumit antara dua pihak, ia mendengarkan dengan sabar kedua belah pihak secara penuh sebelum memberikan penilaian, alih-alih menganggap ia sudah memahami situasinya.

Orang-orang di sekitarnya menyadari bahwa kecepatannya yang hati-hati kadang membuat frustrasi orang yang menginginkan jawaban cepat, namun penilaiannya sangat dihormati justru karena dibangun atas pemahaman penuh.

Orang-orang saat ini yang membuat keputusan penting kadang mengingat kisah ini sebagai panduan. Kisah ini mengingatkan mereka bahwa penilaian yang lebih lambat dan dipertimbangkan dengan baik seringkali jauh lebih berharga daripada yang cepat namun tidak lengkap.
answerKey: Ali ibn Abi Talib was known among the companions for weighing decisions carefully rather than reacting quickly, even in situations where others expected an immediate response from him. When faced with a complicated dispute between two parties, he listened patiently to both sides in full before offering a judgment, rather than assuming he already understood the situation. Those around him noticed that his careful pace occasionally frustrated people wanting a quick answer, yet his judgments were widely respected precisely because they were built on full understanding. People today making important decisions sometimes recall this story for guidance. It reminds them that a slower, well-considered judgment is often far more valuable than a fast but incomplete one.
